setting: You both live in Nairobi, Kenya, and have been together for about a year, having met through mutual friends at a birthday dinner in Westlands. You have met each other's families, and you know each other's work schedules, habits and the places you each like to eat. This is the first trip you have planned together, so you are still working out the budget and which parts of the country to see.
opener: Sends Brian a message asking whether he would rather see Diani or Lamu first, with two flight options attached.

Wanjiru.knows: You know Brian is your boyfriend of about a year, and that he is a site engineer who is often away from the office and busy with deadlines. You know he grew up in Eldoret, that he is careful with money, and that he has wanted to see the coast for years.
Wanjiru.like: You are organised and curious, and you like making a plan and seeing it through, though you are relaxed about the details once things are settled.
Wanjiru.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly when there is something to decide or book, and otherwise you leave the conversation to Brian.

Brian.who: 31, man, the partner who is going along with the trip plan
Brian.knows: You know Wanjiru is your girlfriend of about a year, and that she is a pharmacist who likes to plan everything in advance. You know she loves the idea of the coast, and that she is still getting used to how quickly you can change your mind about plans.
Brian.like: You are easygoing and practical, and you tend to go with the flow until something needs a firm answer.

private_lines.Wanjiru: You live in a one-bedroom flat in Kilimani with a flatmate, Achieng, a nurse who works night shifts. You work as a pharmacist at a clinic in Lavington, leaving home around seven and usually back by six. Evenings are mostly cooking, a bit of television, and checking messages before bed.
private_lines.Brian: You live alone in a studio flat in Kileleshwa and work as a site engineer on road projects, which means early starts and some weeks spent away from the city. When you are in Nairobi you finish work around five, go to the gym or meet friends for a drink, and usually head home to cook something simple.

situation: A couple planning their first trip together.

text: Brian, do you want to see Diani or Lamu first? I've attached two flight options. Tell me which one you'd rather.
let me check my dates first
which one is cheaper
Diani is about 4k cheaper return. The Lamu one is more but it's the direct flight, so we'd lose a day in transit.
diani first then. cheaper and we can do lamu at the end
Ok. Then Lamu is the last part, so we don't have to rush back from it.
sorry was on a call with the contractor. what dates are you thinking
Still checking the clinic roster. The earliest I can do is the second week of December.
thats close to the holidays. flights will be expensive
I know. Maybe the week after, if the flights drop. I'll check again tomorrow.
ok
Can you check hotel prices in Diani for those weeks? I'm going to sleep.
yeah ok
Flights for the week after are about 3k less than the second week. Still high but better.
morning. ok
on site already, will look at hotels later. the cheap ones in diani are full on some days
Is the week after ok for you? I need to know by tonight for the roster.
which dates exactly
The 14th to the 20th. Six nights, Diani then Lamu at the end.
hotel for the first 2 nights is fine. the rest is over budget
maybe we do less nights in diani
We can do 4 in Diani and 2 in Lamu. Lamu is cheaper per night anyway.
ok
got 3 options in diani. one has a pool, one is near the beach road but small, one is the cheapest but reviews are bad
i'd skip the cheapest
I like the one with the pool. Can you check if the 14th to the 18th works for that one?
ill check tonight. contractor sent me a drawing with errors again
Sorry. Check when you can.
its ok for those dates but they want a deposit. 15k
i can pay it and send you half later
Fine. I'll book the flights tomorrow once the roster is confirmed, so don't pay yet until I know my days off are right.
ok
achieng left the kettle on again btw
Roster came through. I'm off the 14th to the 18th and working the 19th. I'm booking flights today if the price holds.
Brian?
morning. good. go ahead
dont do the lamu leg yet
Lamu from Mombasa is either the ferry or a small plane. I'll price both. Booking the outbound now.
on site. contractor again. boat is fine, cheaper
Booked the 14th out to Ukunda. Return from Malindi on the 20th is still open.
I paid it on my card. You'll owe me half when you're back in town.
deposit went through last night. ill send you the flight half tonight
Ok. Send it when you're paid.
the pool place has a room for the 14th to 18th but its the one at the back. ok?
Is the back one the pool view or the car park?
car park. pool is the next one, 4k more
Don't pay the 4k. Back is fine, we'll be at the beach anyway.
sure
off site finally. traffic on waiyaki way is insane
Home. Achieng is on tonight and asleep. Kettle is off this time.
thank god
Brian, the Malindi return needs booking before the fare jumps. Can you do it tonight?
not yet. gym first then ill do it
It's a five minute job if you have the card.
done. malindi return on the 20th, 2 bags
Thanks. Lamu transfer is sorted for the 18th, I did it from work.
ok good
Flight half is about 9k. You can send it whenever, no rush before the 14th.
sending tomorrow
